concerns.text: T006 instructs 'shuffles taxon abundance vectors across patients (block-wise permutation preserving each patient's internal time ordering)', but FR-007 mandates 'shuffling patient identifiers while preserving the within-patient time ordering of the longitudinal MDS-UPDRS total scores'. These are different null hypotheses; an implementer cannot satisfy both, and T006's verification cannot confirm FR-007 compliance. Align T006 with FR-007 or amend the spec.

T001 says 'if none, abort early per plan edge-case handling' when no motor-outcome column exists, while FR-004 requires 'the pipeline will skip the correlation step and log a warning'. T003 correctly implements skip-and-warn. The abort-vs-skip contradiction makes T001's verification ('exits non-zero with a descriptive error') unexecutable against the spec's graceful-degradation requirement. Pick one behavior consistently.

T009 requires permutation empirical p-values to be 'directionally consistent with LME p-values for the top taxa'. This is an outcome-dependent scientific expectation a correct implementation may fail (especially given the FR-007 permutation-design mismatch). Reword to a validity-only check (p in [0,1], computed from the documented permutation scheme) so the test is deterministically executable.

Tasks write deliverables to 'data/results/…' while data-model.md and plan.md specify 'results/…' (and spec.md gives bare filenames). Contract tests in T004/T005/T006 and the FR-008 deliverable check in T011 will check different paths depending on which document the implementer reads. Fix one canonical path in tasks.md.

T004 makes the partial Spearman 'optional' without stating what taxa_correlations.csv reports when it is vs. isn't computed — the schema has only spearman_rho/raw_p/bh_adj_p columns. State deterministically which variant populates the CSV (e.g., always the unadjusted Spearman; partial reported separately or not at all) so the contract test is unambiguous.

T005 uses formula 'Outcome ~ Time * Taxon + …' and accepts 'UPDRS_partIII or MDS-UPDRS total', while FR-005 fixes 'MDS_UPDRS_Total ~ Time * Taxon + Age + Sex + Levodopa_Dose'. The implementer cannot tell whether the alternative outcome column is spec-authorized; T005's verification (coefficient recovery on synthetic data) is executable but the construct being tested is underspecified. State the authorized outcome-column policy explicitly.

T007's 'a check script confirms the logged totals' and T010's 'a check confirms no causal phrasing appears' do not name the artifact (script path / test file) that performs the check. Name the file (e.g., code/tests/test_runtime_budget.py, a text-scan in test_report.py) so done-ness is verifiable.
